claims.statement: MACOM announced customer-side long-term supply agreements with IQE for epitaxial services spanning multiple technologies and described IQE as an important supplier; the announcement did not disclose minimum purchase, product mix, duration, value, or exclusivity.

claims.statement: MACOM proposed a £45 million investment in IQE through equity and a convertible loan note, with board representation, subject at the announcement date to regulatory clearances and customary closing conditions.

source_doc.title: MACOM to Enter into Agreements to Further Strengthen Supply Chain

sources.quote: Long-Term Supply Agreements with IQE for epitaxial services spanning multiple technologies.
MACOM's proposed investment in IQE will total £45 million, in the form of equity and a convertible loan note.
IQE is an important supplier to MACOM.
